definitions.explanation: A collective term for plant life in general, encompassing both grasses and trees. Often used in literary or poetic contexts to refer to nature or the natural world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{草木|くさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{茂|しげ}っている→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧。
examples.english: The plants in the garden are growing thick.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{草木|くさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{芽吹|めぶ}く→芽吹く：13995_mebuku⟧。
examples.english: When spring comes, all the plants begin to sprout at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わり、⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{草木|くさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{色|いろ}づき→色づく：10074_irozuku⟧{始|はじ}める⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ようやく⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れ→訪れ：14267_otozure⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: When the long winter ends and the mountain vegetation begins to take on color, the villagers finally feel the arrival of the warm season.

notes:
USAGE:
{草木|くさき} literally combines ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧ (grass) and ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧ (tree) to mean plant life collectively. It carries a slightly literary or poetic tone compared to simply saying ⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧ (plants).

The fixed expression {草木|くさき}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧⟦{丑三|うしみ}つ{時|どき}→丑三つ時：10089_ushimitsudoki⟧ refers to the dead of night (around 2-3 AM), literally "the hour when even the plants sleep."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {草木|くさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{茂|しげ}る→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧ (vegetation grows thick)
- {草木|くさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{枯|か}れる→枯れる：04589_kareru⟧ (plants wither)
- {草木|くさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{芽吹|めぶ}く→芽吹く：13995_mebuku⟧ (plants sprout)
- {草木|くさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|お}い{茂|しげ}る→生い茂る：22515_oishigeru⟧ (vegetation grows lush)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧: plants (scientific, neutral term)
- ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧: greenery (visual emphasis on the color)
